Where big ideas start small.

A warm, play-based kindergarten and creche for children aged 2.5 to 6, set among rubber trees and green hills, where children learn, play and grow in fresh air.

About us

Rubber Hills Kindergarten is part of the Rubber Hills Group, named for the lush rubber trees and honey-rich land where we belong.

It was founded by Ajin George, a retired Navy veteran, and Luie Femila, a seasoned educator. After retirement, they chose to stay in service and devote their time to shaping young minds.

Our aim is a nurturing place where every child can grow and thrive, in the classroom and on the sports field.

How children learn here

Every day mixes play, stories, movement and quiet time, so children build skills without feeling hurried.

Linguistic

Children meet the alphabet and learn letter sounds through phonics. They practise vowels and consonants by listening, speaking and playing with words.

Numeracy

Children learn to count, recognise numbers and understand early math ideas such as more, less, shapes and patterns, using hands-on activities.

Social development

Children learn about the world around them: their home, school and community. They also learn to share, cooperate and be kind to others.

Art

Children try drawing, painting, colouring and other art forms, and learn to express their ideas and feelings with colour and shape.

Craft

Simple do-it-yourself projects where children cut, fold, paste and build. They grow creative thinking and fine motor skills as they make something of their own.

Games

Playground and park games that keep children active, build strength and balance, and teach teamwork and fair play.

Library

A cosy reading corner where children explore picture books and stories. Reading more helps them think more and builds a lasting love of books.

Puzzles

Puzzles and matching games that help children focus, solve problems and stay with a task until it is done.

Events and celebrations

Special days and celebrations through the year that make school fun, so children look forward to coming every morning.

Creche

A gentle first step into school for our youngest children. They do activities, play, sleep and eat in a small, caring group.
